title: A standalone credit stays on one customer as today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B, so customer A has work billed to someone else.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Add a $15.00 goodwill credit with no invoice.
  3. Open customer B's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • The $15.00 credit shows on customer A only.

Step 3:

  • Customer B shows no $15.00 credit.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
